name: [🐰] Plants & Brainrots 🌻
desc:
🪴 Welcome to Plants & Brainrots!

How to Play:
🌱 Buy a seed & plant it in your garden!
🌻 Your plants fight brainrots for you!
💸 The brainrots generate money!
🍄 Buy more EPIC plants & flex your brainrots!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
